description: Source code implementing encryption and decryption functions for EAD protocol, including key setup, IV management, message hashing, encryption, and decryption.

methods.name: ead_set_key
methods.description: Initializes encryption and decryption contexts with the provided symmetric key, sets IVs and IV increment vector.

methods.name: ead_encrypt_message
methods.description: Encrypts a message, computes SHA1 hash, and appends padding.

methods.name: ead_decrypt_message
methods.description: Decrypts a message, verifies IV and hash, and returns the plaintext length.
